description.value: The Thompson Hotel is a full-service hotel and conference centre in downtown Kamloops offering a range of room types from Double Queen to Family and Double King Suites. The property features an indoor heated pool, fully equipped fitness room with cardio equipment, a 24/7 games room, and an on-site Breakfast Bistro. It is pet-friendly and welcomes guests with dogs, making it a comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring the Thompson Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and richly detailed, confirming the hotel is open and operating. Guest laundry ('Guest laundry available 24/7') is listed in every room-type page, and complimentary wireless internet is confirmed across all room descriptions and the meeting room page. No bike storage, bike room, or cyclist-specific procedures are mentioned anywhere on the website, so required criteria remain null.
concerns: On-site Jacuzzi/Hot Tub noted as closed for maintenance until June 1, 2026 per website — minor and temporary.
Breakfast Bistro operating on reduced seasonal hours (closed some weekdays) per website — cyclists should verify availability before relying on it.
No bike storage or cyclist-specific procedures mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with an active website, verified contact details, and a solid range of amenities useful to touring cyclists.
